svg.text: A bought IP65 box, 120 wide x 90 deep x 120 tall, with four corner

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: screw holes outside the lid seal (90 x 90 mm apart).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bottom: two 16.2 mm holes 30 mm each side of centre, for M16

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: glands: the lead to the node and the switch lead.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top: one 10 mm hole, centred, for the beacon lead; the beacon base

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: covers it with its own gasket and three screws.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Front (lid side faces forward): one 10 mm hole, centred, for the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: horn leads; the horn's flange and gasket cover it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tape the faces, pilot drill 3 mm slowly, open with a step drill.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit the MOSFET driver inside on its standoffs.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: four M5 screws through the corner holes and the back plate,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: every hole covered by a gland, gasket or flange.
